prompts.map: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied existing top-down portrait park GAMEPLAY MAP. Create an alien mosquito invasion NIGHT variant. Preserve EXACT overhead camera, 2:3 portrait aspect ratio, road centerlines/widths, footprint and position of EVERY fountain/pond/playground, park gates and major trees. Especially central fountain at x50%,y48%; pond at x19%,y16%; playground at x79%,y76%. These are collision-registered; do not move/resize them. Preserve the smiling blue jellyfish fountain statue. Change lighting and surface decoration only: saturated deep teal foliage, muted indigo grass, softly illuminated pale lavender stone paths, subtle mint bioluminescent flowers along borders, restrained violet/blue night highlights on water, a few tiny alien crystal clusters embedded within existing tree-border areas. Open grass/path areas must stay quiet, clear and walkable, with no extra rocks/objects. Keep colorful cozy detailed 2D game map illustration, crisp small forms; darkness must not hide obstacles. No characters, enemies, UFOs, stars floating over gameplay, sky/horizon, text, labels, logos or UI. This is a flat opaque full-bleed background map, not a poster. Match exact original map layout with only night/alien atmosphere.
prompts.enemies: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent sprite atlas for three original cute alien mosquito enemies in a cozy hand-drawn chibi game. Layout EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six isolated full-body sprites with wide transparent gutters, same cell dimensions; no grid borders or text. Top row left-to-right: 1 scout, 2 charger, 3 bubble caster. Bottom row: same exact identities/order, second wing-flap pose. Each has compact rounded pear abdomen, oversized expressive glossy eyes, short curly mosquito proboscis, two antennae, six tiny clearly connected insect legs and ONE PAIR of translucent wings. They should read as whimsical mosquito insects, no humanoid clothes/arms, no gore, not realistic pests. Scout: sky-blue/periwinkle body, slender fast shape, warm yellow antenna tips. Charger: richer violet, stockier angled eyebrows, small amber V marking on forehead, determined expression. Bubble caster: lavender/magenta round plump body, mint antenna tips, visible cheek pouches, mischievous expression; NO separate bubbles around sprite (projectiles rendered in game). Two rows retain same head/body size/position, ONLY wings change from raised wide V in row1 to lowered outward wings in row2. Match same thick clean dark navy outlines, soft cel shading, pastel highlights and appealing chibi rendering as reference characters. Front three-quarter facing viewer, small scale-readable silhouettes, wings separate from face. Full body incl antennae/wing/legs within cell; no shadows, sparkles, captions, background, checkerboard or motion marks. Actual transparent RGBA background.
prompts.boss: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent 3 columns x 2 rows, SIX evenly spaced isolated game sprites with wide transparent gutters, no labels/grid. Five poses of ONE original cute powerful alien MOSQUITO KING plus its retreat UFO. Reference 1: reference game chibi rendering style. Design king: pear-shaped violet/plum insect body, big expressive bright blue eyes, a short curled pink mosquito proboscis, two curved antennae tipped with gold lights, six short insect legs, TWO PAIRS of broad translucent blue/lavender wings, small gold crown with violet center jewel, pale mint oval CORE SOCKET centered LOW on belly. Core center remains blank dark disk in every pose; game will overlay core glow. No humanoid clothes/arms. All five king frames preserve exact face, proportions, crown, socket position and center, full-body same scale. Row1 col1 normal flight wings raised, col2 normal flight wings lowered, col3 charge telegraph wings swept upward and angry focused brow. Row2 col1 exhausted core-opening pause, tired eyes and drooping wings; col2 defeated dizzy eyes and drooping antennae, no orbiting stars; col3 a SMALL EMPTY UFO with violet saucer rim, clear cyan glass dome, three warm yellow rim lights, same dark outlined style, facing viewer slightly above. UFO no king inside, no beam attached. Keep king charming and child-friendly, boss recognizable from crown/core/silhouette at phone size. Full antenna/legs/wing tips within own cell, generous gutters. No labels, speech bubbles, equipment, shadows, loose symbols, effects, background or checkerboard. True transparent RGBA.
